coverage.summary: Applies when an owner evicts tenants to remove a Berkeley property from the rental housing market (Ellis Act withdrawal).

evidence.quoted_span: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.
The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.

result.notes: I changed requires_unknown_facts from true to false. The rule applies to any rental property an owner withdraws from the market. It does not depend on a class of buildings that assessor data cannot identify, and it is triggered by an event (Ellis withdrawal). I removed the 'qualifying households' entry from other_conditions and unverifiable_exemptions. It is a criterion for the size of the payment to the tenant household, not a building, unit or owner exemption, and its criteria are not stated in the documents. I did not import Rent Ordinance coverage categories from D009 or D006 (pre-1980, new construction, Golden Duplex, etc.), because those documents describe the Rent Stabilization Ordinance, not the separate Ellis Implementation Ordinance.
